title: Regional data lockdown playbook for high-risk tenants
content:
Purpose and scope:

This document is an operator-focused playbook for performing an emergency regional data lockdown (hard pin) for individual tenants flagged as high legal or regulatory risk. It defines decision triggers, sequencing, automation helpers, operator checks, telemetry queries, customer communication templates, and post-action evidence packaging. Intended audience: SRE on-call, Private Deployments on-call, Solutions Eng, Legal Ops, and Customer Success.

When to use this playbook (triggers):
- Confirmed legal notice/subpoena requiring data remain within a single territory for a named tenant.
- Customer contract change requesting immediate region lock for security/regulatory reasons.
- Verified threat or compromise where cross-region replication must be halted for a tenant.
- Escalation from Legal or Compliance with explicit request to stop cross-border egress.

High-level constraints and safety guarantees:
- Aim to preserve availability where possible; prefer soft pin or session-level workarounds unless legal mandate requires hard lock.
- All actions must be recorded (audit log entry + incident ticket).
- If automation is used, require two-person approval from SRE lead + Solutions Eng or Legal ops.

Pre-action checklist (must confirm before any lock):
1) Tenant ID(s) and tenant owner contact info (CS rep). Confirm with CS/legal.
2) Relevant contract/notice ID and legal owner. Attach to incident ticket.
3) Current region pin state: query tenant_pin table and edge-affinity logs.
4) Telemetry baseline snapshot: last 2 hours of cross-region flows for tenant.
5) Impact assessment: list of integrated connectors (S3, webhooks, subprocessors) and expected downtime risk.
6) Escalation contacts: SRE oncall, Solutions Eng, Legal Ops, PM.

Operator run sequence (recommended):
Step 0 — Create incident ticket
- Create ticket in our incident tracker (e.g., PRJ-XXXX) with title: "REGION LOCK: tenant-<tenant_id> — <country-code>"
- Attach legal notice/contract snippet and CSM confirmation.
- Add tags: region-lock, urgent, legal.

Step 1 — Immediately snapshot evidence and metrics
- Run telemetry queries (examples below) and upload artifacts to ticket.
- Export access logs and KV cache traces for tenant lifetime last 7 days.

Step 2 — Put tenant into soft-fail routing (if available)
- Set routing policy to prefer target-region endpoints only; keep fallbacks disabled. This buys time to validate impacts with lower blast radius.
- Monitor 5–15 minutes for error rates. If errors spike > 5x baseline, abort and prepare rollback.

Step 3 — Execute hard-region pin (if required)
- Use admin pin API: POST /admin/tenants/<tenant_id>/pin with body {region: "eu-west-1", type: "hard", reason: "Legal notice PRJ-XXXX"}.
- Required: add audit fields operator_id and legal_reference.
- Ensure operation returns 200 and job-id.

Step 4 — Enforce storage and subprocessor constraints
- Trigger storage-level tether: call storage-tether service to mark tenant buckets as local-only and disable cross-region replication for the tenant prefix.
- Validate object-list and replication jobs are paused.

Step 5 — Lock network egress for tenant control plane traffic (if mandated)
- Apply iptables / envoy ACL policy at the regional gateway to drop requests destined for other regions for that tenant token.
- Confirm ACLs with test curl from a trusted test tenant client.

Step 6 — Verify and monitor
- Verify in 1, 5, 15, 60 minute intervals: token-level success rates, latency, error codes, backlog size on local queues.
- Keep Legal and CS updated at T+15m and T+60m (templates below).

Rollback criteria and safe abort conditions:
- Customer availability drops below SLA target and Legal accepts temporary exception.
- Data loss or corruption detected in local storage actions.
- Automation step fails with inconsistent state across services.

Rollback sequence (if aborting):
1) Revert pin via admin API with reason "rollback — incident <ticket>".
2) Re-enable replication jobs and storage copy pipelines.
3) Remove ACLs applied to gateways.
4) Run integrity checks on replicated objects and notify CS to validate customer data.

Telemetry queries (examples you can run in observability):
- Cross-region outgoing requests for tenant (pseudo-SQL):
  SELECT count(*) as calls, dest_region FROM request_logs WHERE tenant_id = '<tenant_id>' AND timestamp > now() - interval '2 hours' GROUP BY dest_region ORDER BY calls DESC;
- Active KV cache shards outside pinned region:
  SELECT shard_id FROM kv_shard_map WHERE tenant_id = '<tenant_id>' AND region != '<target_region>';
- Storage replication jobs in-flight:
  SELECT job_id, status, created_at FROM replication_jobs WHERE tenant_prefix LIKE 'tenant/<tenant_id>/%' AND status IN ('running','queued');

Evidence packaging (required if legal notice):
- Minimum required items: copy of legal notice, incident ticket ID, admin API audit log entries, storage tether commands & job ids, telemetry exports (CSV), and operator signed checklist.
- Create a zip: evidence/<tenant_id>/region_lock_<ticket_id>_<date>.zip and upload to legal S3 escrow bucket with KMS tag referencing customer contract id.

Communication templates (shortened):
- Internal Slack update to #private-ops:
  "REGION LOCK: tenant-<tenant_id> pinned to eu-west-1 per legal notice PRJ-XXXX. Operators: Asha, Tom. Impact: replication paused, egress ACLs applied. Monitoring: dashboards link. DO NOT MODIFY PIN WITHOUT APPROVAL."

- Customer-facing (via CS) short note:
  "We have placed your tenant into region-only mode for <country>. This was done in response to legal/contractual request PRJ-XXXX. Expected disruption: none/minor. If you need a temporary exception, reply to this thread and we will escalate to Legal."

Automation helpers and scripts (references):
- admin-pin-cli (repo: private-ops/tools) — cli wrapper for admin pin API (requires 2fa + signoff flag).
- storage-tetherer (service) — token to disable replication jobs for tenant prefixes.
- acl-deployer (ansible playbooks) — gateway ACL change sets.

Testing checklist after lock:
- Run synthetic request suite from within target region and from outside; confirm out-of-region requests are rejected or routed appropriately.
- Confirm no background replication tasks touching tenant prefix.
- Verify telemetry shows 0 outbound flows to disallowed regions within 30 minutes.

Legal and compliance notes:
- Always attach the legal owner and preserve originals. Avoid redacting original notices; instead, mark internal-access-only.
- Evidence retention: keep packaged evidence for 7 years (or contract-specified duration). Use legal-escrow lifecycle policy.
- If subprocessor involvement is suspected (third-party infra), add subprocessor contact list to evidence bundle and notify Legal to pursue contractual obligations.

Post-action and runbook closure:
- After stabilization, schedule a 72-hour review meeting with SRE, Solutions Eng, CS, and Legal.
- Fill out incident postmortem template (linked_artifacts) capturing root cause, timeline, and any required product changes to reduce future blast radius.
- If the lock becomes permanent per contract, transition responsibility to Onboarding/Account Ops for long-term pin maintenance and billing adjustments.

Appendix: quick snippets and templates
- Admin API example (curl):
  curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n    https://admin.redwood.internal/tenants/<tenant_id>/pin \n    -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","type":"hard","reason":"Legal PRJ-XXXX","operator_id":"asha.patel"}'

- Ticket template fields to capture:
  summary, tenant_id, legal_reference, operator_ids, pin_type, target_region, expected_impact, rollback_criteria, evidence_bucket_path

- Example evidence file list:
  - legal_notice.pdf
  - incident_ticket.json
  - admin_pin_audit.csv
  - replication_jobs_snapshot.csv
  - telemetry_cross_region_2h.csv
  - operator_checklist_signed.txt

Open questions and follow-ups (to track in ticket):
- Should we introduce a temporary "quarantine" routing mode that rejects all non-approved integrations without a full hard pin? (proposal: implement in routing edge gateway)
- Add role-based gating in admin-pin-cli to require Legal Ops signoff button in UI.
- Improve telemetry to surface tenant-level replication lag per region (obs ticket: PRJ-5120).

Related artifacts and proposals:
- Confluence: region-pinning-standards (linked above)
- Engineering proposal: tenant-quarantine-mode (RFC #86)
- Observability ticket: PRJ-5120 (tenant replication lag dashboards)

Owner notes (Asha Patel):
- This playbook is intentionally operational and granular. It is a living doc; update the automation references and CLI flags after any changes to admin APIs. If you run a lockdown, please add a short blurb to #private-ops summarizing lessons learned and attach the final evidence zip to the ticket.

End of document.
